topic: What power allocation trade-offs arise from differing scan losses between quasi-TEM and quasi-TE1 modes for multi-beam satellite systems?
consensus_response: Differing scan losses between quasi-TEM and quasi-TE1 modes introduce variable interference, affecting power allocation strategies. Adaptive power allocation mitigates these effects by balancing individual beam powers to minimize interference and maximize capacity, considering demand satisfaction and unmet system capacity trade-offs.
reference_context: Flexible resource optimization and adaptive power allocation are crucial for multibeam satellite systems to manage interference and maximize capacity.
